comments.value:
Current: VRC+: Can make 3 groups

----

Visitor: Cannot make groups, nor upload avatars, nor upload worlds

New User: Can make 1 group for free, upload avatars, upload worlds

User: Can make 2 groups for free

Known User: Can make 3 groups for free

Trusted User: Can make up to 5 groups for free

VRC+: Can make up to 10 groups

----

I can't think of a reason one person would make 10 groups outside of memes...

But the point is more to just let us make at least 1 for free, possibly scale it with your trust, and VRC+ is like a luxury.

I agree that you should need a certain user rank to create a group, however I find people suggesting you should need known/trusted rank being way too excessive!

Currently "New User" allows you to upload avatars/worlds and "User" to submit worlds to community labs. Groups is a core feature and should be unlocked around the same time as other core features becomes available to you. VRC+ should let you create more groups though as that fits with it also increasing your favourites tabs.
@{58c6b8ad227a56787575ebbd|full_name}: I agree, I adjust my suggestion below.

I imagine the point is to prevent too many excess groups flooding in and being both development and moderation nightmare - this is the "testing the waters" period.  It's good to keep awareness on this, but should also not be too impatient.

I think an important way to phrase it is simply, if this is a CORE feature of the game, do you really want to, in anyway, lock it behind a paywall? 

It'd be better for 100 things to break, then to have players be justifably upset that gathering together is a paid feature.

@{5a766b8a0868b44b53569ce4|full_name}: it is

I trust the VRC team to come up with reasonable numbers

@{60e24173af93e3121cc3906e|full_name}: It's probably making them some money back after their losses from people cancelling after the EAC drop.  I'd say they are fully aware of repercussions and chose this path, at least for now, despite that, for their own reasons.  Remember, vrchat still needs to pay it's developers.

@{5a565acbb301553d0104ba88|full_name}: probably make more sense to have new user and/or user make 1 group, and then leave it at that, then let trusted make 2 new ones, then vrc+, maybe or maybe not additional groups, but instead perhaps let them have other perks, like choosing their delimiter number or other things like that.  having a bajillion groups comes off as unnecessary, and you'll get more people making groups just for banner pictures and jokes instead of meaningful ones, flooding the database and api requests with excess nonsense.

Yes!! I agree with this post! I feel as if they should at least make it to where trusted users or known users can own at least one group. 

Though they may have it behind the VRC+ paywall to prevent spam or to support development, I don't think $10 a month is worth keeping a small friend group or community together

Reduces the amount of low effort groups being created. Allows a smaller subset of users to pioneer the feature and any issues that may come in with it without resorting to lottery. Eventually when the dust settles and the systems are fully implemented, they may make group creation not be restricted by vrc+.
@{626493560d0af452a617cccd|full_name}: The problem is ”may”. It shouldnt even be considered at that point. Worrying for the future of other features.
@{632f6928eb2f2944ba51672a|full_name}: Afaik you don't need to pay to KEEP the group, just to make it initially.

comments.mergedPostTitle: Don't need vrc+ to make a group

comments.value:
The VRChat Team must be paid some how; they pay for the hosting of VRChat so that we, the users, can enter for free and upload as much content as we want, they also added a lot of useful features so we can have a better experience in VRChat, people do not work for free.

I don't believe they will remove VRC+ from groups.

@{5f2ffaa2e4df5767fb1e91cb|full_name}: I understand this perspective. But in this scenario the conversation is about a *social* feature, that already has and will continue to make massive changes in coming months as to how people interact with one another.

It most definitely will be the primary way for how people will start finding new friends/communities, as well as keeping track of massive friend's list.

A lot of people make massive amount of content for VRChat already, and quite a bit of them are and have been doing it for absolutely free. VRC+ has and will continue to be paid for by people that are able to afford it even if creating groups isn't paywalled.

At first the narrative was "VRC+ Features are just a bonus, you pay to support developers." but now we are at the point where a *social* feature that will make a massive impact on community interactions as a whole - is gated behind a paywall and may affect interactions of people in a negative way because they are not able to afford VRC+.

In case they need to incentivize more people to subscribe, then that should be done in the way that *does not* limit ways for people to be social with each other.
How the hell does another group post have almost 500 uovotes? This should easily be the most upvoted... sad.
Currently you cannot upload or update banners or icons for groups at all without VRC+...

details:
Current wording being used in the article and the video, seems to present the idea that the requirement for VRChat+ isn't really decided which means that there is a chance "group creation" may not become accessible for non-VRChat+ users.

"We're unsure if VRChat+ will always be required to make a group in VRChat" (https://youtu.be/b6c_kDRJG2A?t=237)

"This requirement could change in the future" (https://help.vrchat.com/hc/en-us/articles/11706395001875-Creating-a-Group)

I think a big portion of the community may get hurt by this requirement, think of groups that may just be made for niche topics, or small creators that may not be capable of paying for a subscription who may want to develop some of their small community too.

I believe people should be able to create communities for each other, and interact with them without being required to subscribe to VRChat+ because i believe this system will be a big contributor to interactions between players.
title: Please do not lock down group features behind VRChat+ subscription.
